reasonText: As per the medical records submitted, Type 2 diabetes mellitus was first diagnosed in 2018 and you have been on oral anti-diabetic medicines since then. The present admission is a complication of this condition. Your policy commenced on 15/06/2024 and only 14 months of cover have been completed. The treatment is therefore not payable as it falls within the 48 months waiting period applicable to pre-existing diseases.
